'''Fahs Oxsor''' was an [[Issori]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was well known for his flamboyant escapades against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Fahs's family was fanatical about their political beliefs, but Fahs was overwhelmed by their beliefs and fled [[Issor]] to pursue a life of adventure. He joined [[Toob Ancher]] aboard the [[Glory (YT-1300 light freighter)|''Glory'']] as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] and first mate. Fahs retired to [[Redcap]], where he spent more than ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] evading the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He eventually became a [[Mining/Legends|miner]].
